ai.title: Bringing the Spark to Europe: Local Intelligence Powers Next Wave of Agents
ai.brief: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing its full lineup of local AI hardware. RTX Spark , which launched last week , powers personal agents on Windows PCs; DGX Spark supports developers building and scaling applications on Linux; and DGX Station serves enterprise teams running frontier workloads on Linux, with a Windows version arriving in December. Learn more about these local AI announcements below, and check out the demos and sessions at GTC Berlin . RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — running personal agents, accelerated content creation and 1440p 100 frames-per-second gaming with up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute. Underdog , a new desktop agent app built for fully local, private AI, is also bringing its experience to RTX Spark.

sec.title: PHP Prepares Emergency Fixes for Two Critical Remote Code Execution Flaws
sec.brief: S. CISA adds Fortinet Multiple Products and BeyondTrust Remote Support flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog PHP is preparing an emergency security release for two critical vulnerabilities that could let attackers execute code remotely on affected servers. The update is scheduled for today, October 21 at 14:00 UTC, after details of the flaws leaked online ahead of their planned disclosure. 2. It hasn’t yet published their technical details, confirmed the affected versions, or identified the releases that will fix them. The official PHP announcement says the full information will accompany the security updates. “The PHP security team would like to give advance notice of an upcoming security release . It is scheduled for Wednesday, 21 October 2026 at 14:00 UTC. ” states the announcement .
